guides.title: PocketTTS · Voice
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.

steps.title: Select a PocketTTS voice
steps.body: Open the Voice tab and read the available voice choices before selecting one. Choose a voice and test a short phrase. If no voice is offered, confirm PocketTTS is the selected backend in the TTS configuration; this tab shapes the voice, it does not activate the backend by itself.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Verify the chosen voice persists
steps.body: Leave and reopen the Voice tab to confirm the voice selection held. A reset selection means the change did not persist. Test once per change rather than switching voices repeatedly, since each test consumes time and can confuse which voice produced the result. Only explicit Save controls exist for Spotify and VoiceStudio; elsewhere settings apply without one.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

guides.title: PocketTTS · Startup
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.

steps.title: Decide when PocketTTS prepares
steps.body: The Startup tab controls whether PocketTTS initializes with the TTS session. Read the current option and consider whether you prefer faster first speech or a lighter start. Restart the session after a change and observe how quickly the first utterance is available.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Inspect startup state after restart
steps.body: After a restart, check the reported PocketTTS state before assuming it is ready. An error at startup often names a missing local model or file. Resolve that message before changing startup options again, and confirm recovery with a short spoken test.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

guides.title: PocketTTS · Advanced generation
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.

steps.title: Inspect advanced generation settings
steps.body: Advanced generation exposes finer speech-production options. Read the current values first, since defaults are usually a sensible starting point. Change one option and test a short phrase to judge the effect. The purpose of this tab is control, not a quick fix for a misconfigured backend.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Recover from an unexpected result
steps.body: If speech becomes distorted after an advanced change, restore the previous value rather than adjusting several options at once. Test the same short phrase each time so the comparison stays fair. If the backend stops speaking entirely, read the TTS status for an error before continuing.

guides.title: PocketTTS · Advanced runtime
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.
learning_outcomes: Confirm the runtime change took effect

steps.title: Review advanced runtime options
steps.body: Advanced runtime holds lower-level PocketTTS options that affect where and how the backend runs. Read each current value before changing one, because runtime choices can affect load time and compatibility on your machine. Change one, then start the TTS session again to observe the effect.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Confirm the runtime change took effect
steps.body: After adjusting a runtime option, restart the TTS session and verify PocketTTS loads without error. A runtime change that prevents loading needs reverting before further testing. Confirm recovery with one short utterance rather than assuming a clean start proves speech quality.

guides.title: PocketTTS · Voice tag rules
guides.description: Understand the shared voice-tag rules alongside this TTS provider.

steps.title: Read the default voice guidance
steps.body: Voice tag rules describe how NC interprets voice tags alongside this backend. Read the default guidance before changing it; backend selection and reference-audio selection are separate choices. Keeping the existing rules gives you a known baseline for later speech comparisons.

steps.title: Distinguish rules from actual playback
steps.body: A saved rule expresses how voice tags should be interpreted, not proof that a backend accepted the reference or produced audio. A later controlled spoken reply is needed to verify routing. If output changes unexpectedly, compare the rules with their previous text before changing provider settings.
